title: StoneOutline
description: A normalized, millimetre-space outline any consumer may read. This is the single contract that makes the Setting System shape-agnostic: a bezel consumes these points without knowing whether they came from a native cut, a custom outline, or a projected imported solid.

isPolygonal.description: True for an exact closed polygon; false when the outline is a SAMPLED approximation of a curve, so a consumer can tell the difference.
